recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It preserves the original Jira decision, respects the later module refactor, and fixes the only discovered current navigation defect tied to the retired Foundation Module exchange-use section.
issue_request: FHIR-11330 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue asking to correct old Foundation Module wording that said FHIR supported 3 exchange paradigms even though Services was the intended fourth paradigm.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in svn @10162, represented in git by 83f1205cc1, which changed source/foundation-module.html from 3 to 4 exchange paradigms and added Services. The exchange-use section was later moved out of Foundation by c397bd0b1f into source/exchange-module.html.
additional_context: The current source/exchange-module.html is active in source/hierarchy.xml and already lists recognized exchange methods including Services, plus later additions for Database / Persistent Storage and Subscriptions Framework. Current-source searches found no remaining stale paradigm-count wording. The remaining defect was source/modules.html linking implementers who ask how information is exchanged to the removed foundation-module.html#uses anchor.
reconciliation: Updated source/modules.html so the Getting Started exchange question links to exchange-module.html and labels it Exchange Module. The already-correct exchange-method list was left unchanged.
source_changes: source/modules.html: changed the Getting Started exchange guidance link from foundation-module.html#uses (removed anchor) to exchange-module.html and updated the link label to Exchange Module.
